# PR — 263_R6FIX.13 · the change-plan billing fence

**Branch:** `stevevitali/r6fix-13-billing-fence` · **Base:** `main` · **mergePolicy:** OPERATOR — this run does not merge.

## What

`POST /billing/subscription/change-plan` (reached from the app as `POST /app/settings/billing/change-plan`) now answers a **typed, non-mutating refusal**: `403 {error:"change_plan_unavailable"}` for every caller — before the body is parsed, before any transaction opens. No record write, no Stripe call, no silent 200, no crash. This fences the in-app switch path that silently diverged from Stripe billing (F-R6FIX.5-1 / D-R6FIX.5-1 — `changePlan` wrote local tier/grants but Stripe kept billing the inline-`price_data` subscription).

The refusal class matches the repo's feature-off pattern (`purchase_closed`, REQ-BILL-16 / R7COPY.1c): the api's stable code rides `ApiError.code` → `billingFailureCode` → `?notice=change_plan_unavailable` → `billingNoticeFor` → the new sentence **"Plan changes are off right now — your current plan is unchanged."** No current surface links to change-plan (verified — the ladder renders only subscribe/cancel/waitlist/topup/auto-reload/portal), so the UI leg is the honest code→copy map for any future linker.

`changePlan` stays in the ledger as the mechanism the D-R6FIX.5-1 registry ticket re-enables; the route comment names the re-enable point.
